pages.text: Merging the mechanics of $(thing)Create$() with spatial casting allows rotational force to bridge vast distances and dimensions.$(br2)By attuning two or more $(item)Phase Relays$() to the same channel, they form an uninterrupted kinetic circuit.
$(bold)Ethereal Star$().$(br)Transforms the targeted shaft into a $(bold)Transmitter (TX)$() bound to the specified channel.
$(bold)Enclosed Star$().$(br)Transforms the targeted shaft into a $(bold)Receiver (RX)$() bound to the specified channel.

pages.title: Network Physics
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Direct Stress:$(/) Machine load on the RX line immediately applies back to the TX source.$(br)$(li)$(bold)1:1 Speed:$(/) Rotational speed (RPM) is transferred without loss.$(br)$(li)$(bold)Overstress:$(/) If demand exceeds capacity, both networks stall simultaneously.
